  btf_func_proto_check kernel/bpf/btf.c:4506 [inline]
  btf_check_all_types kernel/bpf/btf.c:4734 [inline]

  __sys_bpf+0x50a/0x6c0 kernel/bpf/syscall.c:5034
  __do_sys_bpf kernel/bpf/syscall.c:5093 [inline]
